negative_anchor: b5644f8: argument position alone does not explain candidate silence (40/40 provider, 40/40 recipient, 40/40 candidate across all realization classes)

phases.Phase_L: active: lexical-semantic coverage with syntax held constant
phases.Phase_C: gated: discourse/complexity ONLY after Phase L is evaluated; same-verb design; metaphor excluded to a later figurative-semantics class

hypothesis.H1: Candidate Generation loses genuine provides relations disproportionately for lexical realizations outside the established trigger core, even in simple syntax.
hypothesis.H0: Candidate recall does not materially depend on lexical realization given simple syntax.

test_design.frame: identical syntactic frame within pair (ditransitive or prepositional-dative, both canonical)

lexical_groups.L1: established core (provide, supply, offer, give: proven 40/40 in argument-realization probe)

freshness_rule: test lexemes must NOT be copied from batch-6 FN sentences (no give off, leaven, assist, serve as, fund, provide access, bring); batch-6 FNs stay held-out validation, never construction material
no_controls: matched NO sentences: same frame, predicate with clearly no provides-reading; measures false-candidate rate so a permissive generator cannot fake recall

decision_rule.lexical_support: test groups materially lower than L1 in identical frames, reproducing across multiple independent lexemes
decision_rule.inconclusive: differences depend on individual lexical items
decision_rule.negative_result: open Phase C (discourse/complexity); do not modify candidate generation

phase_C_sketch_gated.constraint: same licensed/recognized verb throughout, so only complexity varies
phase_C_sketch_gated.excluded: metaphor/figurative semantics (own later class, e.g. batch-6 case 055)

forbidden_during_probe: no candidate-generator fix after Phase L before asking why
research_question: Is candidate silence a problem of lexical-semantic coverage (Phase L) or of discourse/structural complexity (Phase C)?
test_material: not yet built; pairs to be generated once, validated, pair_id-split, and frozen in a separate step
